text: Subject: GC/MS Analysis of Sample AB-133
Sample AB-133 was prepared by S. Phillips for GC analysis by diluting
with dichloromethane (1:21, v:v). A 1 μ1 injection of the dilute solution
was made on a fused silica capillary column coated with DBwAx. The Table
below refers to the two chromatograms, and lists those GC peaks examined by
GC/Ms. The identifications were made from the best matches of the mass
spectrum with those in our libraries. Where the relative retention times
match with those of authentic compounds, an asterisk (*) follows the RRT
value. Note that this same sample type has been analyzed as AA-233, with a
memo sent to you on March 20, 1989.
